```{r}
# Create Enceladus configuration
enceladus <- EnceladusConfig$new()
```


```{r}
props <- enceladus$get_derived_properties()
```


```{r}
# Print initial configuration details
print("Initial configuration properties:")
print(props)
```


```{r}
# Plot gravity profile
enceladus$plot_gravity_profile()
seafloor_g <- enceladus$calculate_gravity(enceladus$core_radius)
print(paste("Gravity at seafloor:", seafloor_g, "m/s^2"))
```


```{r}
# Create and run hydrothermal simulator
sim <- Simulator$new(
  k = 1e-12,              # Permeability [m²]
  layer_thickness = 600,   # Layer thickness [m]
  porosity = 0.32,        # Porosity [dimensionless]
  config = enceladus      # Use our Enceladus configuration
)
```


```{r}
# Run simulation
results <- sim$run_simulation(timesteps = 1000)
print("Simulation results summary:")
print(sim$get_summary_metrics())
```

```{r}
# Generate simulation plots
plots <- sim$generate_plots()
print("Simulation plots:")
print(plots)
```


```{r}
# Initialize PHREEQC integration
phreeqc <- PhreeqcIntegrator$new(sim)

# Generate PHREEQC input file
phreeqc_file <- phreeqc$generate_phreeqc_input()
print(paste("PHREEQC input file generated:", phreeqc_file))

# Print PHREEQC parameters
print("PHREEQC scaling parameters:")
print(phreeqc$phreeqc_params)
```

```{r}
# Run parameter sweep
print("\nRunning parameter sweep...")
parameter_sweep <- expand.grid(
  k = c(1e-13, 1e-12, 1e-11),          # Permeability range
  layer_thickness = c(500, 1000, 194.2e3),   # Layer thickness range
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)


# Initialize results storage
sweep_results <- list()

for(i in 1:nrow(parameter_sweep)) {
  print(sprintf("\nRunning scenario %d of %d:", i, nrow(parameter_sweep)))
  print(parameter_sweep[i,])
  
  tryCatch({
    # Create and run simulation
    sim_i <- Simulator$new(
      k = parameter_sweep$k[i],
      layer_thickness = parameter_sweep$layer_thickness[i],
      config = enceladus
    )
    
    sim_i$run_simulation()
    metrics_i <- sim_i$get_summary_metrics()
    
    # Create PHREEQC input
    phreeqc_i <- PhreeqcIntegrator$new(sim_i)
    phreeqc_file <- phreeqc_i$generate_phreeqc_input()
    
    # Store results with consistent structure
    sweep_results[[i]] <- list(
      params = data.frame(
        k = parameter_sweep$k[i],
        layer_thickness = parameter_sweep$layer_thickness[i]
      ),
      metrics = data.frame(
        mean_flow_rate_Ls = metrics_i$mean_flow_rate_Ls,
        circulation_time_years = metrics_i$circulation_time_years
      ),
      phreeqc_params = phreeqc_i$phreeqc_params,
      phreeqc_file = phreeqc_file
    )
  }, error = function(e) {
    warning(sprintf("Error in scenario %d: %s", i, e$message))
    # Store empty but properly structured result
    sweep_results[[i]] <- list(
      params = data.frame(
        k = parameter_sweep$k[i],
        layer_thickness = parameter_sweep$layer_thickness[i]
      ),
      metrics = data.frame(
        mean_flow_rate_Ls = NA,
        circulation_time_years = NA
      ),
      phreeqc_params = list(),
      phreeqc_file = NA
    )
  })
}
  


```

```{r}
# Summarize sweep results
print("\nParameter sweep summary:")
sweep_summary <- do.call(rbind, lapply(sweep_results, function(x) {
  data.frame(
    k = x$params$k,
    layer_thickness = x$params$layer_thickness,
    mean_flow_rate = x$metrics$mean_flow_rate_Ls,
    circulation_time = x$metrics$circulation_time_years
  )
}))
print(sweep_summary)
```
```{r}
# Create summary plot
sweep_plot <- ggplot(sweep_summary, 
                    aes(x = log10(k), y = layer_thickness, 
                        size = mean_flow_rate, color = circulation_time)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_viridis_c() +
  labs(x = "log10(Permeability [m²])",
       y = "Layer Thickness [m]",
       size = "Mean Flow Rate [L/s]",
       color = "Circulation Time [years]") +
  theme_minimal()
print(sweep_plot)
```
```{r}
# Create integrator with 15% organics
phreeqc <- PhreeqcIntegrator$new(sim)
phreeqc$calculate_phreeqc_parameters(organic_wt_percent = 15)
phreeqc_file <- phreeqc$generate_phreeqc_input()
```


```{r}

config <- EnceladusConfig$new()

# Step 2: Create the hydrothermal simulator

  k = 1e-11,              # Permeability [m²] 
  layer_thickness = 194.2e3,  # Permeable layer thickness [m]
  porosity = 0.32,        # Porosity [fraction]
  config = config         # Enceladus configuration
)
```
